scenes.headline: How a labelled dataset becomes an RL environment
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Corvo! Here's how two ordinary datasets, documents and speech, became environments a model can learn from.

scenes.text: Keep the reference on a server, grade every answer with one fixed function, and any labelled dataset becomes something GRPO can train against.
scenes.mark: grade every answer with one fixed function
scenes.say: The idea: hide the answer on a server, and grade every attempt with one fixed function.

steps.say: The server holds the dataset: rendered pages, or speech clips in over a hundred languages.
Reset hands the model a crop or a clip. Never the answer.
The model writes a group of attempts.
Step sends each one back. The server compares it with the hidden reference and returns a reward.

parts.note: e is the edit distance over the reference length
parts.say: Most of the reward is one minus the error rate, so every small fix pays.

parts.note: a looping answer clamps to zero
parts.say: A looping answer clamps to zero.

parts.note: a fifth for getting it exactly right
parts.say: A fifth is kept for an exact match.

left.title: What the grader counts
items: Vowel signs count on their own
left.say: In Kannada, the grader counts code points. Drop a doubled consonant, and you pay twice.

right.title: What a reader sees
items: Normalised first, so encoding is free
right.say: A reader sees one syllable wrong. Both servers normalise Unicode first, so encoding never costs reward.

items.say: For speech, the model trained on every Kannada training clip.
Sixteen transcripts per clip, graded on characters.
The clip has to reach the loss, or the model learns sentences instead of listening.
Test sentences never appear in training.

scenes.title: Kannada speech: how much lower the error is
scenes.note: same predictions, four ways of averaging
scenes.say: Forty-five percent holds on the average the card chose. Counted as raw edits, it is closer to forty-two, partly from writing numbers as digits.

scenes.label: lower Sarvam CER on 300 real Kannada crops
scenes.say: For documents, trained on synthetic pages and tested on real printed crops, character error fell about sixteen percent.

scenes.text: The grader is the environment: its normalisation, its unit and its length guard decide what the model learns.
scenes.say: The grader is the environment. Its normalisation, its unit and its guards decide what the model learns.

recap: Hide the reference on a server
Grade every answer with one function
scenes.say: To recap: hide the reference, grade with one function, and choose your unit on purpose.
